summary: The proof is complete: the affine shear places the selected fiber centroids in an r-dimensional residual subspace, the accepted mixed centerpoint theorem supplies a lattice-base point of the required atomic depth, convex-hull separation places that point in the sheared body, and the accepted centroid halfspace bound converts every captured atom into the corresponding fiber-volume contribution. The halfspace restriction, vertical-halfspace, r=0, singleton, improper-halfspace, and inverse-shear cases are all handled correctly.
